check_service_status.description: Check whether The Color API is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it.

mock_response.message: The Color API is up and answering.

check_service_status.name: check_service_status

message.description: What was found, in one sentence.

online.description: True when the service answered with a color.

reachable.description: True when the service answered at all, even with an error.

response_time_ms.description: How long it took to answer, in milliseconds.

status_code.description: The HTTP status it answered with; empty if none.

compare_colors.description: Compare two colors: how readable text in one is on the other, as the WCAG contrast ratio with a pass or fail at each level, and how far apart they look, as a colour difference where about 2 is the least a person notices and 100 is black against white. Both colors come back fully identified, so a step can also tell whether they share a name or are the same color spelled two ways. The service has no route for any of this; both colors are identified and the rest is worked out here.
compare_colors.name: compare_colors

parameters.description: The color, in any of these formats: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). Three bare numbers are read as rgb, three with a percent sign as hsl and four as cmyk. Wire in a value from an earlier step, or type one.

generate_scheme.description: Generate a color scheme from a seed color: shades of the one hue, its neighbours on the color wheel, its opposite, or three or four hues evenly spaced around it. Every color in the scheme comes back fully identified, with its name and every format, and the hex codes as a plain list for a step that only wants those. Ask for 1 to 50 colors; the service's own default is 5, and a triad always has at least 3 and a quad at least 4.

parameters.description: The color, in any of these formats: a hex code such as #0047AB or 0047AB, rgb(0,71,171), hsl(215,100%,34%), hsv(215,100%,67%) or cmyk(100,58,0,33). parameters.description: How the scheme is built from the seed. Monochrome keeps the hue and varies the lightness; analogic takes the neighbouring hues; complement takes the opposite hue; triad and quad space three or four hues evenly. Defaults to monochrome.

identify_colors.description: Identify a list of colors in one step, up to 10 at a time, in the order given: a brand palette, the colors pulled out of a design file, the swatches in a spreadsheet column. Each is looked up as Identify a color does, one request each, and the names and hex codes come back as plain lists beside the full records. description: Identify, convert and scheme colors with The Color API, the free keyless color service. Give it a color in any format, hex, rgb, hsl, hsv or cmyk, and get back its name, every other format and the text color that reads best on it; convert one value into another format; generate a monochrome, analogic, complementary, triad or quad scheme from a seed color; check how readable one color is on another against the WCAG contrast levels; pick a random color that a seed makes repeatable; or identify a whole list of brand colors in one step.
